name: ml-startup-pitch
prompt: Create a pitch deck for my ML startup called 'DataForge'. Include a user growth chart showing 1K, 5K, 20K, 80K users over Q1-Q4, a bar chart comparing our model accuracy (94%) vs competitors (87%, 82%), and an architecture diagram showing our microservices setup with API Gateway, Model Service, Data Pipeline, and PostgreSQL.
expected_features: Chart.js or ECharts loaded via CDN
At least one line/bar chart with user growth data
Comparison bar chart with accuracy data

name: api-metrics-review
prompt: Here's our API metrics: {"endpoints": [{"path": "/users", "avg_latency_ms": 45, "p99_latency_ms": 230, "requests_per_day": 50000}, {"path": "/orders", "avg_latency_ms": 120, "p99_latency_ms": 890, "requests_per_day": 25000}, {"path": "/search", "avg_latency_ms": 200, "p99_latency_ms": 1500, "requests_per_day": 15000}], "error_rate": 0.3, "uptime": 99.95}. Create a 10-slide technical review with performance charts.

name: microservices-teaching
prompt: Make a teaching presentation about microservices architecture for a university class. Include architecture diagrams showing monolith vs microservices, a sequence diagram for an API call flow, and code examples in Python showing a FastAPI microservice.
expected_features: Code slides with Prism.js syntax highlighting

name: quick-status-update
prompt: Create a quick 5-slide status update with a bar chart comparing Q1 vs Q2 results: Revenue Q1=$2.1M Q2=$2.8M, Users Q1=45K Q2=62K, NPS Q1=42 Q2=51.
expected_features: Bar chart with Q1 vs Q2 comparison

name: incremental-enhancement
prompt: Add 3 slides about our new caching layer to this existing presentation at ./presentation.html. The caching layer uses Redis with a 15-minute TTL, reduced average latency by 60%, and handles 100K requests/second. Include a before/after latency chart and a client-server diagram showing the cache.
expected_features: Preserves existing slide styles and structure
